relevance.rationale: WRONG JOIN. The seeded id was garoufalidis-gu-marino2021, whose registered entry names a three-author paper at a different arXiv identifier. This PDF is arXiv:2111.04763v2 [math.GT] with FOUR authors and a different subject (the resurgent structure at the TRIVIAL flat connection) — and the registered entry's own note explicitly calls it out as a separate, later work. No key exists for it, so id is null. A SECOND AND LARGER PROBLEM surfaced while checking this: the same key is being used in the corpus for a THIRD paper. Fourteen Lean sites cite garoufalidis-gu-marino2021 with the locator 'GGM 2012.00062' — QOU/QBeta/DeltaLambdaT5Assembly.lean:53, ThetaRealityBound.lean:44, BarOddQOneCentringNonselective.lean:81, DeltaLambdaBindingAssembly.lean:43 ('Theorem 9'), IotaOddSaddleOffsetAmphichiral.lean:89, StokesQZeroDTCount.lean:47 ('eq 59a sandwich, eq 60, Thm 9 det W_m = 2'), FiveTwoDTSpectrumSplit.lean:77, G3RealnessConjugationBrick.lean:49, StokesSymmetryConstant.lean:46, WindingGFTransform.lean:48, Stokes3LargeOrderAmplitude.lean:62, StokesSymmetryConstantQZero.lean:57, plus GZWeightGeneral.lean:32 and OneInstantonNormalization.lean:46 which mix the registered identifier with a second one. arXiv:2012.00062 is registered in references.ts under a DIFFERENT key (garoufalidis-gu-marino2023peacock). So those sites cite equation and theorem numbers belonging to one paper under the key of another: the locators are almost certainly right, the key is wrong. That is a miscited-claim defect at scale, sitting in the QBeta Stokes-constant modules the 1ppq A_omega work depends on.

keyResults.statement: Complete description of the resurgent structure of the Chern-Simons series at the TRIVIAL flat connection for a hyperbolic knot complement, via an extended matrix of (x,q)-series indexed by the boundary-parabolic flat connections including the trivial one; gives an analytic extension of the Kashaev invariant and an exact form of the refined quantum modularity conjecture.
keyResults.useForFolio: The trivial-flat-connection sector is the one the QBeta Stokes modules are missing: the existing citations cover the non-trivial connections, while the framework's q = 0 / centring arguments live precisely at the trivial connection.

proposedActions.rationale: This four-author sequel has no ref() entry and is currently mis-joined to the three-author paper. Register it from its own front matter.

Fourteen QBeta Lean sites cite equations and theorems of arXiv:2012.00062 under the key garoufalidis-gu-marino2021, while references.ts registers that arXiv item under garoufalidis-gu-marino2023peacock. Re-key those sites so the Stokes-constant locators point at the paper that actually contains them.
